lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam vakhaanai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he chants the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam rataa din raatee maaiaa mohu chukaahaa he ||8||
lines.translation: Night and day, he remains imbued with the Naam, day and night; he is rid of emotional attachment to Maya. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te sabh kichh paae ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, all things are obtained;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai meraa aap gavaae ||
lines.translation: egotism, possessiveness and self-conceit are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aape kripaa kare sukhadaataa gur kai sabade sohaa he ||9||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace Himself grants His Grace; He exalts and adorns with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad a(n)mrit hai baanee ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Shabad is the Ambrosial Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin har kaa naam vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: Night and day, chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: har har sachaa vasai ghat a(n)tar so ghat niramal taahaa he ||10||
lines.translation: That heart becomes immaculate, which is filled with the True Lord, Har, Har. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak sevahi sabad salaahahi ||
lines.translation: His servants serve, and praise His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ra(n)g raate har gun gaavahi ||
lines.translation: Imbued forever with the color of His Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਪਰਮਲ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase sabad milaae paramal vaas man taahaa he ||11||
lines.translation: He Himself forgives, and unites them with the Shabad; the fragrance of sandalwood permeates their minds. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੇ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade akath kathe saalaahe ||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, they speak the Unspoken, and praise the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere prabh saache veparavaahe ||
lines.translation: My True Lord God is self-sufficient.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape gunadaataa sabad milaae sabadai kaa ras taahaa he ||12||
lines.translation: The Giver of virtue Himself unites them with the Shabad; they enjoy the sublime essence of the Shabad. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bhoolaa thaur na paae ||
lines.translation: The confused, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s karam kamaae ||
lines.translation: They do those deeds which they are pre-destined to do.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਖੋਜੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaa raate bikhiaa khojai mar janamai dukh taahaa he ||13||
lines.translation: Imbued with poison, they search out poison, and suffer the pains of death and rebirth. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap aap saalaahe ||
lines.translation: He Himself praises Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere gun prabh tujh hee maahe ||
lines.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are within You alone, God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: too aap sachaa teree baanee sachee aape alakh athaahaa he ||14||
lines.translation: You Yourself are True, and True is the Word of Your Bani. You Yourself are invisible and unknowable. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur daate koi na paae ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਜੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh kotee je karam kamaae ||
lines.translation: though one may make hundreds of thousands and millions of attempts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te ghat a(n)tar vasiaa sabade sach saalaahaa he ||15||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, He dwells deep within the heart; through the Shabad, praise the True Lord. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan mile dhur aap milaae ||
lines.translation: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord unites with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachee baanee sabad suhaae ||
lines.translation: They are adorned and exalted with the True Word of His Bani, and the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jan gun gaavai nit saache gun gaavah gunee samaahaa he ||16||4||13||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; singing His Glories, he is immersed in the Glorious Lord of Virtue. ||16||4||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal ek sadaa sach soee ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is eternal and unchanging, forever True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur te sojhee hoee ||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har ras bheene sadaa dhiaain guramat seel sa(n)naahaa he ||1||
lines.translation: Those who are drenched with the sublime essence of the Lord, meditate forever on Him; following the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the armor of humility. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar ra(n)g sadaa sachiaaraa ||
lines.translation: Deep within, they love the True Lord forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam piaaraa ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they love the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh naam vasiaa ghat a(n)tar chhodiaa maaiaa kaa laahaa he ||2||
lines.translation: The Naam, the embodiment of the nine treasures, abides within their hearts; they renounce the profit of Maya. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raeeat raaje duramat doee ||
lines.translation: Both the king and his subjects are involved in evil-mindedness and duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve ek na hoee ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, they do not become one with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ek dhiaain sadaa sukh paain nihachal raaj tinaahaa he ||3||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the One Lord find eternal peace. Their power is eternal and unfailing. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa rakhai na koee ||
lines.translation: No one can save them from coming and going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maran tisai te hoee ||
lines.translation: Birth and death come from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh saachaa sadaa dhiaavahu gat mukat tisai te paahaa he ||4||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the True Lord. Emancipation and liberation are obtained from Him. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sa(n)jam satiguroo duaarai ||
lines.translation: Truth and self-control are found through the Door of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai krodh sabad nivaarai ||
lines.translation: Egotism and anger are silenced through the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeeai seel sa(n)tokh sabh taahaa he ||5||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is found; humility and contentment all come from Him. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mohu upajai sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: Out of egotism and attachment, the Universe welled up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag binasai naam visaaraa ||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all the world perishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve naam na paaeeai naam sachaa jag laahaa he ||6||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. The Naam is the True profit in this world. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa amar sabad suhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: True is His Will, beauteous and pleasing through the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad mil vaajaa vaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resonate.
